declarations.name: AuiHeatmap

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby); also the data table caption.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (matrix size, lowest and highest value with their cells).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for cell labels, legend step ranges, tooltips, the data table, and the summary.

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Column labels (x axis), in order (mirrored in RTL).

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Row labels (y axis), top to bottom.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: values[row][column]: exactly one array per row and one value per column. null, NaN, and infinities are empty cells ("No value").

inputs.name: colorScale
inputs.description: { type?: 'sequential' | 'diverging' (default sequential), color?: 1-8 (sequential slot, default 1), negative?: 1-8 (default 2), positive?: 1-8 (default 1), midpoint?: number (diverging center, default 0), min?, max? (fixed domain; default the nice-rounded data extent), steps?: 3-9 (per side for diverging, default 5) }. Values outside a fixed domain use the first or last step.

inputs.name: xAxis
inputs.description: Column axis title (drawn below the plot).

inputs.name: yAxis
inputs.description: Row axis title (drawn beside the row labels); also the header of the data table's first column (default "Row").

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

inputs.name: renderTooltip
inputs.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

inputs.name: syncGroup
inputs.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: Legend listing every color step with its value range; auto and show both show it, hide removes it. Entries are not toggle buttons.

inputs.name: dataTable
inputs.description: Data table fallback with the exact matrix: behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus (cell name and value).

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.description: Shared chart option (toggles aui-chart--patterns); heatmap cells and step swatches are not textured, so it has no visible effect.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container. Cells share the plot evenly.

inputs.name: cellLabels
inputs.description: Values printed inside cells: auto and always print them where the formatted value fits (always skips cells that are too small); none prints no values.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Number and message locale.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors the columns (first column at the right), puts the row labels on the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

models.name: hiddenSeries
models.description: Shared chart option; a heatmap has no series, so it has no effect.

outputs.name: pointClicked
outputs.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Shared chart method; a heatmap has no series, so it only re-renders.

accessibility.pattern: SVG matrix chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "heatmap") of role="img" cells with two-dimensional roving focus; a legend listing every color step with its value range; data table fallback with the exact matrix.

limitations: Discrete steps only (3-9, per side for diverging); no continuous color ramp.
One palette slot (sequential) or two (diverging); no custom color stops.
cellLabels 'always' prints values only where they fit, like 'auto'.
